evidence_scope: Official product documentation; no competitor UI, demand or performance validation

documented_facts: Automatic photo/video upload from selected device albums when the app opens/resumes and periodically in background.
Default Wi-Fi-only upload can be changed; iOS background refresh and Android battery optimization affect scheduling.
Can mirror mobile albums as server albums one-way; has a reorganize action to backfill existing uploads.
Calculates a checksum to skip content already on the server.
does_not_support: The documentation does not establish cross-product backup compatibility or guarantee background execution timing on mobile operating systems.
A checksum skip is not evidence of Cairn's complete SHA-256 plus logical-length identity contract.

documented_facts: Documents contextual CLIP search using VectorChord and Postgres.
Advanced filters cover location, one or more faces, albums, people, contextual content, filename/extension, full path/folder, and display states such as favorites/archive/not in album.

The current Search types table explicitly includes OCR (text in images), camera make/model/lens, time frame, descriptions and tags. Verified in the root full primary-document open, not inferred from an earlier search excerpt.
does_not_support: Does not demonstrate that Cairn's text BGE profile provides image-context search.
Does not establish accuracy, demand, or usability for any particular household library.

documented_facts: Detects and groups faces into people that may be named and searched; people appear in Explore and asset details show detected faces.
Documents cover photo, hide, birth date, merge, and favorite controls.
Processing uses generated previews, face detection and recognition models, embeddings, and incremental clustering; models may be downloaded and hardware acceleration is configurable.
does_not_support: Does not establish that automatic face assignments are always correct or suitable as durable user-authored tags.
Does not establish that face processing is cheap on low-power NAS hardware.

documented_facts: Albums can be shared to instance users with viewer/editor permissions.
Public links can share selected assets or albums and can have expiry, password, and action controls; public links can permit recipient uploads.
does_not_support: Does not define Cairn's authorization, link revocation, or export-manifest semantics.

documented_facts: External libraries index photos/videos stored outside Immich into the main timeline and permit map viewing and album assignment.
External changes require rescanning; metadata changed in Immich is stored in Immich and is not written to the external asset file.
does_not_support: Does not imply all external-library changes are immediately detected or that Immich metadata is embedded into originals.

documented_facts: Provides native iOS and Android apps distributed through app stores and other listed channels; login uses a server endpoint URL.
does_not_support: The opened page excerpt alone does not document a complete mobile viewer/navigation feature set.

documented_facts: Responsive UI documents left navigation among Photos, Albums, Places, and Settings; top search accepts terms and filters; view modes include cards, mosaic, and list.
does_not_support: Responsive web layout does not establish native mobile background backup behavior.

documented_facts: Documents Search, Albums, Unsorted, Videos, Live Photos, People, Favorites, Moments, Calendar, Places, Regions, Labels, Folders, Private, and Originals sections.
Calendar is organized by capture time; Places uses location information; Moments are automatically created albums.
does_not_support: The documentation does not show that every library will yield useful Moments, labels, or location facets.

documented_facts: Indexing originals leaves existing files/folders unchanged, extracts metadata and can make existing folders appear as albums.
Import copies or moves files to originals, skips duplicates, assigns unique names and sorts by year/month; original filename is indexed as a property.
Indexing creates thumbnails and optionally JSON/YAML metadata sidecars.
does_not_support: Import's duplicate behavior does not establish the Cairn exact identity or deletion policy.

documented_facts: Manual albums can be created and edited; multiple selected photos/videos can be added, removed, and one item set as cover.
does_not_support: Does not document ordering, shared collaboration, or frozen exact-version export semantics in the cited page.

documented_facts: Face recognition detects faces during library scan and groups similar faces; person naming and starred people are documented.
Recognition waits until the library has been fully scanned and may cause high CPU load; the guide documents new clusters and correction behaviors.
does_not_support: Does not establish acceptable error rates, privacy suitability, or performance for Cairn target hardware.

documented_facts: The opened official documentation page is titled Places and is listed in PhotoPrism's organization guide.
does_not_support: The opened page exposed no substantive body text in the browser result, so it does not support claims here about map behavior, geographic fields, or offline geocoding.

documented_facts: PhotoPrism identifies its platform-independent PWA and lists separately maintained third-party Android gallery, iOS/Android PhotoSync transfer, and iOS Stream apps.
The documented apps have distinct developers/licenses; the guide describes timeline browsing for Gallery and direct transfer for PhotoSync.
does_not_support: These third-party integrations do not establish that PhotoPrism itself ships a first-party native mobile application.

documented_facts: Web portal has Photos, Albums, Sharing; Photos supports personal/shared spaces and timeline/folder modes, upload, filters, slideshow, and batch actions.
Documents automatic albums by faces, objects/themes, location, tags, file types, and date; documents mobile backup, search, sharing and Apple TV/Android TV or casting.
does_not_support: The page documents Synology's DSM-integrated product; it does not support equivalent deployment portability or behavior on arbitrary NAS platforms.

documented_facts: Android app documents Timeline and Folder view, manually/automatically created albums, Sharing, spaces, backup progress/status, and cache settings.
Automatic backup supports personal/shared destination and a custom path; documents status/error visibility and free-up-space for backed-up items.
Documents Places map, keyword search, People/Subjects/Similar Items/Tags/Videos/Recently Added albums, photo detail edits, widget, and security/passcode lock.
Auto-backup stability depends on OS background-data, battery optimization, charging, and focused-backup conditions.
does_not_support: Requires Synology Photos on DSM 7.2+ per the page; it is not a portable client/server feature specification for Cairn.
Does not establish that deleting backed-up phone items is safe without an independent verified-recovery gate.

documented_facts: iOS app documents timeline/folder, albums, sharing, personal/shared spaces, slideshow, map view, search, cache/offline viewing, HEIC/HEVC preview assistance, and backup states.
Backup depends on iOS background refresh scheduling; page says Image Assistant generates JPEG previews for HEIC/HEVC and consumes network resources.
does_not_support: Does not establish guaranteed timing of iOS background uploads or universal browser codec support.

documented_facts: Standalone responsive web interface and Subsonic-compatible server.

Supports large collections, metadata tags, compilations, multi-disc box sets, playlists, dynamic playlists, per-user play counts/favorites/playlists, optional multi-library access, transcoding, scrobbling, lyrics, jukebox, and public links.

Subsonic compatibility lists tag-based browsing/search, playlists, favorites and ratings for artists/albums/tracks, transcoding/downsampling, and get/save play queue for continuation on another device.

Does not browse actual folders as its primary organization; it simulates folder browsing from tags. Compatible clients span mobile, desktop, TV, CarPlay and Android Auto, with capabilities dependent on the client.
does_not_support: Does not establish that every compatible client has the same queue, offline, artwork, or playback behavior.
Does not constitute an evaluation of actual usability or evidence of demand among single-person NAS owners.
Does not support the claim that playback verifies exact source bytes or Cairn recovery.

documented_facts: Library grouping is based on embedded metadata tags rather than actual folder or filename organization.
Recommended core tags include title, artist, album, album artist, and track number; disc number and release date support multi-disc/release ordering.
Distinguishes album artist from track artist and recommends explicit multi-valued artist tags for collaborations.
Embedded and sidecar cover art are supported; consistent tags and art improve grouping and browsing.
does_not_support: Does not establish universal metadata correctness across all tagging formats or damaged/incomplete libraries.
Does not establish that metadata matching or artist IDs are exact byte identity.
Does not provide demand or task-usability evidence.

documented_facts: The official search excerpt says Navidrome can use artist and album art from configured local and external sources; full details were not verified in an opened document.
does_not_support: Does not guarantee artwork availability or correctness for every album or artist.
Does not establish that external enrichment is privacy-neutral or available offline.

documented_facts: The official search excerpt describes JSON-defined dynamic playlists and labels the feature beta; full behavior was not verified in an opened document.
does_not_support: Does not establish a polished visual rule editor; the overview describes such an editor as roadmap work.
Does not make a dynamic playlist semantically equivalent to a static ordered playlist, player queue, SavedView, LinkGroup or ExportManifest.
Does not establish actual usability or demand.

documented_facts: Albums use one folder per album; embedded track metadata takes precedence over filenames, with filenames used as titles when metadata is absent.
Multi-disc albums use disc number and total-disc tags; tracks for all discs may be placed in one album folder.
Documents synchronized and unsynchronized sidecar lyrics; synchronized lyric lines can seek playback.
Documents embedded or local sidecar music and artist images, plus cover fallback from the first track with embedded artwork.
Documents music format/container caveats, including cases that are not recognized as music or may have browser playback issues.
does_not_support: This page does not establish queue synchronization, saved queue behavior, offline downloads, or client parity.
This page does not establish music-specific search behavior or playlist semantics.
Documentation of player features is not byte-verification or preservation evidence.

documented_facts: The official search excerpt describes libraries as virtual collections that can use multiple paths and recommends dedicated media types over mixed libraries; full details were not verified in an opened document.
does_not_support: Does not establish that the library abstraction should become Cairn's physical storage or catalog model.
Does not prove useability or demand for a mixed content view.

documented_facts: The official Plexamp page search excerpt lists playback, car integration, casting, visualizers, mixes, similarity, radio, lyrics, downloads, and other features; availability, entitlement, and details were not independently verified in an opened document.
does_not_support: Marketing feature listing does not establish availability on every platform, detailed semantics, or hands-on quality.
Does not establish that Plexamp is fully self-contained without Plex account/server or subscription prerequisites.
Does not provide demand evidence for these features among Cairn's target users.

documented_facts: The official Plex Music page search excerpt lists artist and album browsing, genre sorting, multi-disc support, metadata editing, lyrics, loudness leveling, fades, and visualizers; details were not verified in an opened document.
does_not_support: Does not establish the exact current behavior of all Plexamp screens or features; the article is an overview of Plex Music.
Does not establish single-user NAS usability or demand.

documented_facts: The official support page search excerpt describes a mutable playback queue, its distinction from a permanent playlist, and different insertion behavior for Play Next and Add to Up Next; full details were not verified in an opened document.
does_not_support: Does not establish equivalent semantics in Navidrome, Jellyfin clients, or Cairn.
Does not make the transient queue equivalent to a LinkGroup or frozen export manifest.

documented_facts: Downloads transfers personal Plex Media Server content to supported player apps for offline use; supported content can include albums, artists, playlists and tracks.
The documented supported apps include Android, iOS, Linux, macOS and Windows applications.
The feature requires an active Plex Pass condition and may require the server owner to allow downloads.
does_not_support: Does not establish universal client support, arbitrary file placement, download conflict handling, or Cairn's recovery semantics.
Does not prove downloaded/transcoded copies are byte-identical to protected originals.

documented_facts: The official search excerpt describes audio-derived similarity, track and album radio, and mixes available through Plexamp; current entitlement and detailed prerequisites were not verified in an opened document.
does_not_support: Does not establish that acoustic similarity is a reliable music identity or exact-content signal.
Does not establish that sonic analysis should be a prerequisite for preservation or baseline search.
Does not demonstrate usefulness for a particular user's library.
